name: Woizer Voice AI
author: Woizer

sections.description:
Woizer Voice AI adds an intelligent voice assistant widget to your WordPress site. Visitors can talk to the AI agent, ask questions about your products and services, place orders, and get help — all hands-free.

Key Features:

  • Voice-first AI assistant that answers questions about your business
  • Automatic WooCommerce catalog sync — your agent knows your products, prices, and availability
  • Quick setup — the plugin sends your site’s content to Woizer directly, so your assistant is ready in seconds
  • Customizable widget appearance (color, position, greeting, theme)
  • Works in Hebrew, English, and 20+ languages
  • Real-time product sync — agent stays up-to-date when you add or change products

How It Works:

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Connect to your Woizer account (free to start)
  3. The plugin automatically collects your site content, products, and contact info
  4. An AI voice agent is created in seconds — ready to help your visitors

WooCommerce Integration:

When WooCommerce is active, the plugin automatically syncs your product catalog including names, prices, categories, descriptions, images, and stock status. The voice agent can answer product questions, recommend items, and take orders.

External Service Notice:

This plugin relies on two Woizer services, operated by Woizer:

  • api.woizer.com (your Woizer account). When you connect the site, the plugin sends its published pages and posts, navigation, contact details, opening hours (from Rank Math or Yoast Local SEO, when set), shipping zones and, with WooCommerce, its products as WooCommerce’s Store API lists them, so Woizer can build your AI assistant. When your products or their stock change, it sends the updated product list (in the background, a minute later), and again every six hours. When you edit a page or post, it sends the site’s pages again (five minutes later). When you disconnect, it tells Woizer. Nothing is sent before you connect, and password-protected pages are never sent. After you connect, Woizer may also visit your site’s public pages, the way a visitor would, to learn its navigation and colors.

  • voice.woizer.com (the voice assistant). On your site’s public pages the plugin loads the Woizer widget script from this service, and a visitor’s conversation with the assistant goes through it once they start one.

  • Terms of Service: https://woizer.com/terms

  • Privacy Policy: https://woizer.com/policy
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for “Woizer Voice AI”
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate
  3. Go to Settings > Woizer Voice AI
  4. Click “Connect to Woizer” and follow the setup
  5. Your voice assistant is live!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Woizer account?

Yes, a free Woizer account is required. You can create one during the plugin setup.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin works on any WordPress site. WooCommerce integration adds automatic product catalog sync.

What languages does it support?

The voice agent supports Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, French, and 20+ additional languages.

Is it free?

Woizer offers a free tier with limited usage. See woizer.com/pricing for details.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Connecting from Settings > Woizer Voice AI is kept: the connection has its own option, which saving the widget’s appearance never touches (before, the page showed “not connected” and syncing stopped)
  • Sites connected with an earlier version move over by themselves

1.1.0

  • Products are read the way WooCommerce’s Store API lists them: each variation by its name, product links, SKUs and stock
  • Stock changes from orders, variation edits and deleted or restored products update the assistant
  • A store that removes every product no longer keeps an old catalog
  • Page content made with Elementor, blocks or shortcodes is read as visitors see it
  • The returns, terms and privacy pages come first; then the pages your menus link to
  • Shipping zones, and opening hours from Rank Math or Yoast Local SEO, are sent
  • Editing a page or post updates the assistant five minutes later
  • Password-protected pages are never sent
  • “Connect to Woizer” connects to the assistant you already made for this site

1.0.1

  • Catalog sync and disconnect prove the site with a secret Woizer issues at connection.
  • Connecting, syncing and disconnecting reach Woizer’s account API (api.woizer.com); they went to the voice service, which doesn’t serve them.
  • The external services notice lists both Woizer services and what each receives.
  • The settings page shows the Woizer icon (the file was missing).
  • Product changes reach Woizer in the background a minute later, as one list: a checkout no longer waits for it, and a large catalog arrives whole.
  • Questions in the block editor’s Details blocks are read as FAQ.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • WordPress site data collection (pages, navigation, contact info, FAQ)
  • WooCommerce product catalog sync
  • Customizable widget appearance
  • Automatic and manual catalog sync
